messages.content: Create stairs by incrementally indenting each new line. Describe technologies without being constrained by existing scientific principles

message.content:
A device that converts entropy into negative mass,
    a communication medium that transmits through tomorrow,
        a fuel that ignites most violently in absolute zero,
            a material simultaneously crystalline and gaseous at the same coordinate,
                a lamp that emits photons of negative energy, heating cold into warmth,
                    a machine whose sole fuel is the precise instant it is switched off,
                        a currency that appreciates in value the moment it is spent,
                            a gravity well that only pulls on objects not yet conceived,
                                a color perceivable exclusively by the sense of hearing,
                                    a clock that measures the duration of events that never occurred,
                                        a mirror reflecting not what you were, but what you will choose to forget,
                                            a seed that grows downward into the concept of soil rather than soil itself,
                                                a language spoken only in the pause between two thoughts,
                                                    a key that unlocks doors by locking them more completely.
